FULL TEXT:
STENOGRAPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2025
NOTICE
No.- 38/R&A Dated: 1st July, 2026
The final result of Stenographer Recruitment Examination, 2025 was notified vide Court Notice
No. 20/R&A dated 23.04.2026. Out of 88 finally selected candidates, the following 08 candidates
have prayed for extension of joining time before the stipulated last date of joining to the post of
Stenographer as per the appointment letter, i.e., 26.05.2026:
It is hereby informed to all concerned that the Hon’ble Court have been pleased to grant them
extension of joining time till 29.07.2026. The candidates are informed to report for joining to the
aforesaid post in the Recruitment & Appointment Cell of the Court by 29.07.2026 with all required
documents as mentioned in their appointment letters.
By order of the Court
Sd/- Shiv Gopal Mishra
Registrar General
